title: Multicriticality in the Generalized Schwinger Model
summary: We consider the generalized Schwinger model. This theory is obtained by coupling the field strength to an auxiliary scalar field $B$ and allowing generic potentials $V(B)$. We study the properties and phases of the model, focusing on the case where the potential is quartic. We investigate the model using both semiclassical and numerical methods, and find a rich phase diagram in the space of couplings.
